plugins.name: nuff
plugins.description: Deprecated, replaced by nuff-skills: takes an Azure DevOps work item as input and does enough work to get it done.

plugins.name: nuff-skills
plugins.description: Good enough skills for day-to-day AI work: grill an idea into a plan, implement it and open the pull request, with a model from another provider reviewing both the plan and the code in a loop.

plugins.name: nuff-hooks-cc
plugins.description: Claude Code only: good enough guardrail hooks - read only from the Workspace, configured roots and (on Windows) D:\, write only to the Workspace, move removed files to Trash (D:\.slop-trash on Windows, ~/.slop-trash on Linux and macOS).

plugins.name: nuff-hooks-copilot
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot CLI only: good enough guardrail hooks - read only from the Workspace, configured roots and (on Windows) D:\, write only to the Workspace, move removed files to Trash (D:\.slop-trash on Windows, ~/.slop-trash on Linux and macOS).

plugins.name: nuff-cc
plugins.description: Claude Code only: good enough Claude Code mods - a desktop status line (context size, prompt-cache countdown, session cost) and opening the session's folder in VS Code from a button above the prompt or /vscode.

plugins.name: nuff-pulse-cc
plugins.description: Claude Code only: hooks that record each session's state (working, needs you, done, error, ended) to a local file for the nuff-pulse widget.

plugins.name: nuff-pulse-copilot
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot only (Copilot CLI, the GitHub Copilot app, VS Code's Copilot agent host): hooks that record when a session's turn is done or the session ends to a local file for the nuff-pulse widget.
